messages:
Aisha Patel: Hey team — quick question. We need to share ~2 days of dev/sandbox logs with an external contractor for connector testing. They only need request/response pairs. Is this allowed and what redaction approach should we use? Who needs to approve?

sec-bot: FYI policy: https://internal.redwood/security/logs-share — PII must be removed or irreversibly pseudonymized. Keys/secrets must be redacted. Please open a security ticket and include sample redacted output.

Tom Nguyen: For dev speed: can we hash user_id instead of dropping the field so they can link events? If so, do we use HMAC with a per-share salt or a single project-wide salt?

Maria Gomez: Short answer: prefer irreversible hashing w/ per-share salt. Do NOT keep the salt with the shared dataset. Better: HMAC-SHA256(user_id, SHARE_SPECIFIC_SECRET) and truncate to 16 chars. Redact emails/phones completely. Also remove any auth tokens or session ids.

Maria Gomez: Example (python):
```python
import hmac, hashlib
SALT = b'share-2026-04-01'
def hash_id(uid):
    return hmac.new(SALT, uid.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:16]
```

Maria Gomez: And include a small README describing the fields removed vs hashed.

Leo Brooks: Adding: this can be approved for non-prod sandboxes only. Please add security@redwood.com + privacy@redwood.com to the ticket and attach a sample of 100 rows redacted. I'll sign off if samples look good.

Aisha Patel: Got it — I'll open the ticket. Quick follow-up: do we need a DPA or other legal paperwork for this contractor before sharing redacted logs? They are a small integration shop.

Maria Gomez: Yes, vendor must have DPA or relevant data processing clause. If they only see irreversibly hashed ids + no PII, legal still wants a minimal DPA. Mark classification: Internal - Sensitive in the ticket.

sec-bot: Reminder: create the ticket with these items: scope, sample redacted file, redaction script, retention window, list of people who get access, and auto-revoke date. :lock: :calendar: 

Aisha Patel: Thanks — I'll include the script + sample and add the vendor DPA link. Will ping when ticket created. :pray:
